rawContent: Speaker Moore’s anti-protestor bill HB805 is now up. He says “recent events have shown us that this is not unique to one side of the aisle” and he was “disgusted” at what happened last summer during Raleigh #BLM protests. https://t.co/qSD0P6RJx3 #ncga https://t.co/Bv9QOeav1B

Speaker Moore says misdeamenor charge only for protesters “is not right” wants “heightened penatlies” for “mob rule.” As part of his argument he compares Raleigh #BLM protests to Black murders to capitol riots where people were murdered. 

#ncga #ncpol #defendtherighttoprotest
Rep. Adams in supporting HB805 points to “pulling down statues” as part of what he’d want heightened penalties for. #ncga #ncpol #defendtherighttoprotest #BlackLivesMatter

Moore points to his condo downtown and his view to last summer’s #BLM protests as central to what drove this bill. Alternatively, Rep. Loften, who is Black, says his concern is his sons who attended #BLM protests with him. “It has the effect of chilling free speech.” #ncga

@ACLU_NC Melissa Price Kromm of @NCVCE on what HB805 is really about: “For many...protest is the only way that they can be heard…let’s be honest they are anti-#BlackLivesMatter bills.” #ncpol #ncga #defendtherighttoprotest
